paper_metadata.title: Investigating Brain White Matter in Football Players with and without Concussion Using a Biophysical Model from Multishell Diffusion MRI

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study uses a well-defined registry (CARE Consortium) and describes inclusion/exclusion criteria clearly. However, the sample size is relatively small (n=78) and represents a specific subset of a larger cohort, which may introduce selection bias. The participation rate of eligible vs. non-participating athletes is not explicitly stated.

items.evidence_snippet: The study included 78 collegiate athletes (24 football players with sports-related concussion, 26 football players with repetitive head impacts, and 28 non-contact-sport control athletes), available through the Federal Interagency Traumatic Brain Injury Research registry.
items.reasoning: The source (FITBIR registry/CARE Consortium) and the specific groups (SRC, RHI, HC) are clearly defined.
